summary: Cloud account permission propagation delay blocking Dedicated onboarding — ephemeral role grants not visible
description:
Issue summary:
During Dedicated customer onboarding (acct: rw-dedicated-205), newly-created ephemeral IAM roles and cross-account bindings are not being recognized by the Dedicated provisioner for ~10-30 minutes after creation. This blocks instance bootstrapping and agent registration, causing onboarding to stall.

Impact:
- One enterprise Dedicated onboarding is delayed (customer facing).
- Provisioner repeatedly times out creating GPU pools and fails health-checks.
- Risk: SLA miss for Dedicated onboarding window; engineering time spent manual-troubleshooting.

Environment:
- Dedicated provisioning pipeline (k8s provisioner service) running in prod us-east.
- Affected cloud accounts: AWS: 111122223333 (customer-managed), AWS: 444455556666 (ops bridge account).
- Identity paths used: cross-account assume-role via ops-broker, STS sessions created with session tags.

Expected behavior:
- New IAM roles and role-attachment policies should be immediately available for assume-role flows; provisioner should proceed without manual retry.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Trigger Dedicated onboarding run for customer acct 111122223333 using provisioning job v2026-03-12.
2) Provisioner creates role 'DedicatedProvisioner-ephemeral-<random>' in ops bridge account and attaches trust policy.
3) Provisioner attempts sts:AssumeRole into the new role for instance bootstrap.
4) AssumeRole fails with AccessDenied for 10-30 minutes, then begins to succeed without other config changes.
logs:
Provisioner logs (excerpt):
- 2026-03-12T18:02:14Z ERROR assume_role failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::444455556666:assumed-role/ops-provisioner-session is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/DedicatedProvisioner-ephemeral-7421
- 2026-03-12T18:07:33Z WARN retrying assume_role (attempt 5)
- 2026-03-12T18:12:21Z INFO assume_role succeeded
Associated CloudTrail events show role creation at 2026-03-12T18:01:58Z and subsequent PutRolePolicy calls. No admin revokes recorded.
investigation_notes:
Initial hypotheses:
- IAM eventual consistency / IAM cache window in AWS for cross-account trust changes.
- Org SCP or IAM propagation lag due to recent org policy changes (we rolled org tagging enforcement yesterday).
- STS session tag truncation or size causing policy conditions to not match immediately.
- Provisioner using a cached credentials path / role ARN that needs refresh.

What we've checked so far: 
- Verified role exists and trust policy includes ops-provisioner ARN.
- CloudTrail shows role and policy put events before failed AssumeRole attempts.
- No deny entries in Access Advisor or service control policies at timestamp of failures.
- Tested manual assume-role from an ops engineer machine immediately after creation: initially received AccessDenied, succeeded ~11 minutes later.
- Confirmed provisioner retries succeed without code changes.

Temporary mitigation applied:
- Updated provisioning runbook to wait 15 minutes after role creation before first assume-role attempt when creating ephemeral roles. This is live for current onboarding runs.

Next investigatory actions planned:
- Open AWS support ticket with Cloud Support to verify backend eventual-consistency windows for cross-account trust changes and tagging conditions.
- Add extra diagnostic tracing: capture IAM/GetRole and sts:GetCallerIdentity immediately before and after create to compare policy eval.
- Audit recent org-policy/tagging changes (rolled 2026-03-11) for any propagation impacts.
- Consider switching approach to pre-create ephemeral roles earlier in pipeline and promote to active state via a toggle to avoid on-the-fly creation race windows.
comments: 2026-03-12 | Marco Liu: Took ownership. Reproduced locally using a sandbox account; observed same ~12min gap. Added debug to provisioner to emit full assume-role error metadata.
2026-03-12 | Elena Ruiz (Security): Confirmed no org SCP denies at the time. Raised that we changed org tag enforcement policy yesterday; could be related.

2026-03-13 | Marco Liu: Filed AWS SR 789203423 (internal reference). AWS support requested CloudTrail snippets and role ARNs; provided. AWS acknowledged this may be an eventual-consistency window and is investigating internal replication logs.

2026-03-13 | SRE Oncall (Carlos Mendes): Implemented temporary 15-minute pause in provisioning CI for ephemeral role path and reran the onboarding job; job progressed to agent registration after pause. Logged workaround in runbook section 'ephemeral-role-wait'.
resolution: Workaround applied: provisioner now enforces a configurable wait (default 15m) after creating ephemeral cross-account roles. Long-term: engineering to implement pre-provision phase and consult with AWS on fixing replication/propagation. Pending AWS SR outcome and internal follow-ups.
